description: Hand-checked .keylayout fixtures and the canonical form (schema 1, documented in _shared/lua/layouts/keylayout.lua) every parser must produce from them. 'error' fixtures must be refused. Replayed by the macOS and Linux Lua suites and by the Python converter tests; the web composer and the AutoHotkey parser replay it when they adopt the form. Real layouts: composed.canonical.json (the composer corpus layout) and, for every registry layout, tools/test/test-keylayout-canonical-parity.cjs.

vectors.name: everything: modifiers, bases, duplicates, entities, comments
vectors.keylayout:
<?xml version="1.1" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE keyboard SYSTEM "file://localhost/System/Library/DTDs/KeyboardLayout.dtd">
<keyboard group="126" id="-1" name="Edge & Co">
  <!-- <keyMapSet id="ghost"><keyMap index="0"><key code="0" output="no"/></keyMap></keyMapSet> -->
  <layouts>
    <layout first="1" last="1" mapSet="other" modifiers="m1"/>
    <layout first="0" last="0" mapSet="set1" modifiers="m1"/>
  </layouts>
  <modifierMap id="old" defaultIndex="9"/>
  <modifierMap id="m1" defaultIndex="0">
    <keyMapSelect mapIndex="1"><modifier keys="anyShift caps?"/></keyMapSelect>
    <keyMapSelect mapIndex="2"><modifier keys="rightOption"/><modifier keys="option shift? control?"/></keyMapSelect>
    <keyMapSelect mapIndex="3"><modifier keys=""/></keyMapSelect>
  </modifierMap>
  <keyMapSet id="set1">
    <keyMap index="0">
      <key code="0" output="a"/>
      <key code="0" output="shadowed"/>
      <key code="1" action="dead_acute"/>
      <key code="2" output="éé"/>
      <key code="3" output=""<>&'"/>
      <key code="4"/>
      <key code="4" action="a_grave"/>
    </keyMap>
    <keyMap index="1" baseMapSet="set1" baseIndex="0"/>
    <keyMap index="2" baseIndex="0">
      <key code="0" output="A"/>
    </keyMap>
    <keyMap index="2" baseIndex="1">
      <key code="9" output="z"/>
    </keyMap>
  </keyMapSet>
  <keyMapSet id="other"><keyMap index="0"><key code="0" output="o"/></keyMap></keyMapSet>
  <actions>
    <action id="dead_acute">
      <when state="none" next="acute"/>
      <when state="acute" output="é"/>
      <when state="acute" output="ignored"/>
    </action>
    <action id="a_grave">
      <when state="none" output="a"/>
      <when state="acute" output="" next=""/>
    </action>
    <action id="a_grave"><when state="none" output="duplicate action is dropped"/></action>
    <action id="empty"/>
  </actions>
  <terminators>
    <when state="acute" output="´"/>
    <when state="acute" output="ignored"/>
    <when state="grave"/>
  </terminators>
</keyboard>
